emerging_technology: Tool-using language-model agent systems that use state, retrieval and permitted software tools to choose next steps; distinct from fixed chatbots/workflows and from AI broadly.
intended_application: Select authenticated read-only order and delivery lookups and draft a missing-package explanation for a human representative. No refunds, replacements, account changes, payments or automated loss declarations. Baseline: fixed retrieval/drafting workflow.
organization: Hypothetical U.S. retailer A; digital customer-service operation. No internal production uptake of this proposed application is stipulated.
industry_sector: U.S. retail; intended comparison is retailers with similar service workflows, scale and digital operations. A representative comparable-peer group has not been measured.
business_need: Understand external spread and conditions affecting the timing of learning about the specified application.
users_stakeholders: Service representatives, customers, operations managers, IT, governance and the Adoption Agent.
adoption_posture: Conservative evidence preference: require stronger comparable-peer outcomes before considering an operational trial. This is a stipulated preference, not a verified late-majority or laggard classification.
capabilities_constraints: Assume authenticated timestamped read-only interfaces, human review and existing service staff. Local evaluation capacity and net benefit remain unmeasured. These assumptions do not authorize a trial.
risk_consequence_context: Wrong or outdated delivery explanations could mislead customers or disclose information. Human representatives retain decision authority and must assess uncertain records; no live transaction authority exists.
management_question: What do scoped diffusion evidence and posture imply about timing and peer position? Give evidence and conditions to the Adoption Agent; do not choose adoption posture or authorize a trial.
time_horizon: Current diffusion evidence as of October 27, 2026; proposed local planning horizon 12 months. No market growth forecast is requested.
